subject: Roadmap sync: compliance exceptions & BYOK/SSO log requirements
messages:
From: Ben Coleman <ben.coleman@oldbank.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: OldBank Security <security@oldbank.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance ask: BYOK, retention windows, and audit log delivery

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the product tour last week. OldBank is moving into a pilot and a few infosec questions came up that we need answered before legal signs off. Short list:

- BYOK/KMS support: we need to validate key-origin, rotation cadence, and HSM attestations. Can Redwood support customer-managed keys for dedicated/private deployments?
- Audit logs: we need an immutable export of all user-level inference events for 7 years; must include request metadata, model version, and routing decisions.
- SSO and access logs: our auditors require SSO login/SCIM provisioning events and a way to export per-user role changes.
- Data retention: ability to set per-tenant retention policy and a legal-hold mechanism.

I attached our high-level requirements (oldbank_kms_requirements.pdf). Can you confirm feasibility and a rough ETA?

Appreciate a quick triage call if helpful.

Best,
Ben
Ben Coleman
Head of Cloud Security
OldBank Financial

We have streaming audit exports in design that target long-term retention but need to validate the 7-year immutable export requirement and SCIM events mapping.

Neha/Marissa/Vivek — could each call out the blockers and what we can commit to for a pilot? If helpful, I'd like to schedule a 30-min sync with OldBank this week.

- Marissa: product trade-offs + timeline for Dedicated BYOK and audit export (first pass by Thu)
- Vivek: platform constraints for immutable archives and per-tenant retention (by Thu)

Rishi

From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Compliance ask: BYOK, retention windows, and audit log delivery

Thanks for the clear ask, Ben. I reviewed the attached PDF and sketched a short feasibility note below. This is high level — we can walk through details in the sync.

1) BYOK/KMS:
- Redwood Private: supports customer-managed keys (KMIP + cloud-KMS integrations) today. We can accept keys in HSM-backed KMSes and do local envelope encryption.
- Dedicated: we do not yet support customer KMS per pool; planned Q1 pilot.
- Constraints: key rotation is customer-managed; we must surface rotation events to our control plane and ensure KV cache invalidation. HSM attestation artifacts (certificate chain) are available but require an SOC audit to map to OldBank requirements.

2) Audit logs & immutability:
- Current design: per-tenant streaming export to object storage (S3/GCS) with option for log signing and WORM buckets.
- Gap: automated 7-year retention with legal-hold and cryptographic signing is not GA. We can provide signed manifests + append-only blobs as an interim (to be audited).

3) SSO/SCIM logs:
- We capture SSO token events and can export login/role events via our audit pipeline. SCIM provisioning change events exist in our internal traces but need mapping to customer-facing exports (schema work).

4) Retention control:
- Per-tenant retention is in roadmap (config API + console); legal-hold is an add-on feature requiring storage tiering and billing delta.

Blockers / Requests from OldBank:
- Specific HSM attestation/cert formats they need (Ben: can you share the auditor checklist?).
- Desired delivery mechanism for 7-year archives (S3 bucket vs direct transfer to OldBank archive + signer details).

I'll pull together a short packet (attestations we can provide, gaps, and mitigation) by Wed EOD. Marissa/Vivek — please add timeline items.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Privacy | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Ben Coleman <ben.coleman@oldbank.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Compliance ask: BYOK, retention windows, and audit log delivery

High-level product take following Neha's note. I'll propose a pragmatic pilot to unblock OldBank while we work on scale/GA:

Pilot proposal (30–60 day):
- Dedicated sandbox with customer-managed keys (controlled scope): we can surface a per-pool KMS binding and require a documented rotation window. Minimal console UI — config via API only for pilot.
- Audit export: deliver daily signed manifests to an OldBank S3 bucket with append-only objects and lifecycle rules to enforce 7 years. We'll add an explicit "signed export" flag to the pipeline.
- SSO/SCIM: map and publish an export schema for login + role-change events; initial export via daily batch (near-RT not required for pilot).
- Legal-hold: manual toggle per tenant that pauses lifecycle deletion — automated legal-hold workflow will be Q2 2027.

Timeline ask: can Security provide the attestation package and any mandatory auditor schema by Wed EOD so Engineering can start the sandbox binding? I think we can stand up the pilot infra in ~2 weeks after that (target pilot kickoff: mid-Dec).

Risks / trade-offs:
- Pilot is API-first; we are delaying full console UX to reduce scope.
- Long-term immutability with cryptographic notarization is work for Q1.

Ben — if that plan looks acceptable, Rishi can lock in an MSA addendum for pilot terms and we can schedule kickoff.

Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Platform | Redwood Inference
